name: Chemical Mistake
source:
The protagonist, Akechi, and the heroine, Tominaga, find themselves held captive in a prefabricated laboratory. Trapped in a facility filling with poison gas and under the watchful eyes of chemist suspects, they join forces to escape—but Akechi is suffering from temporary amnesia and cannot recall a crucial piece of information... What fate awaits Akechi?

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/chemical-mistake-switch/]Nintendo[/url]]
